interpretation: Two separately evaluated configurations, one closed-loop episode each; no pooled angles, no statistical/causal solver proof

workspace.basis: Boya nominal palm and middle/distal CAD meshes transformed by original grasp44 body frames; task-region approximation, not a proven controllability boundary.
workspace.height_basis: Palm top plus cylinder circumsphere radius: even a palm-supported cylinder is below this center-height plane. No claim that every position above is recoverable.
workspace.lateral_basis: Fixed nominal middle/distal mesh XY envelope expanded by cylinder circumsphere radius; all five fingers included.
workspace.contact_policy: Per-finger simulation contact diagnostics only; fewer than two fingers does not terminate. No tactile array or new actor input.

metrics.stall_definition: Pending calibrated observation resolution and agreed window; no guessed threshold
